config.input_output_contract: Full GPU-resident displacement, velocity and scalar physical wave speed to both full GPU-resident fields at all 49 observations. Include projection, every cold-fit start, parameter preparation, evolution and dense output; exclude host transfers, compilation and mesh-only assembly.
config.selection: Frozen MLP32 with same primary time grid; unpreconditioned warm-started CG with declared tolerances, full compiled solve and counted true residuals. No tolerance selection on evaluation.
config.claim_scope: Two existing development inputs per boundary; same-grid semidiscrete references only. FOM uses matched implicit-midpoint time grid; nonlinear ROM retains verified RK4 dynamics. No continuum or matched-accuracy claim.
